Data:Talk.feed.beast.hint.json.label: Feed the Beastie?
Data:Talk.feed.beast.hint.json.startdescription: Use a Soul card and suitable Sustenance. [Food will make a hungry beast, or a wild one, co-operative.]

Data:Talk.feed.beast.json.label: Feed the Beastie
Data:Talk.feed.beast.json.startdescription: Satisfy this creature's appetite. [Food will make a hungry beast, or a wild one, co-operative.]
Data:Talk.feed.beast.json.desc: A full belly makes a helpful friend. [This beastie is now inclined to co-operate.]

Data:Talk.fisherman.intro.done.hint.json.label: Suspicion Allayed, Already
Data:Talk.fisherman.intro.done.hint.json.startdescription: 'Ar?' [The gentleman wishes you to understand that he's talked enough and that he would like to get out of the rain now, please and thank you. Use him to unlock the path up the cliffs.]

Data:Talk.fisherman.intro.json.label: Allaying Suspicion
Data:Talk.fisherman.intro.json.startdescription:
'Be someone that'll speak for 'ee?'

(Of course. Since 1930 and the Restoration, the locals have grown ever more suspicious of foreigners. But there is someone in Brancrug I know...)
Data:Talk.fisherman.intro.json.desc: 'I'll take 'ee by the cliffs, then.' [This gentleman is no longer Sceptical. Use him to unlock Brancrug Village.]

Data:Talk.full.beast.hint.json.label: A Well-Fed Beastie?
Data:Talk.full.beast.hint.json.startdescription: It has no interest in food just now.

Data:Talk.handle.beast.hint.json.label: Time with the Beastie?
Data:Talk.handle.beast.hint.json.startdescription: [Add a Soul card to interact with the beast.]

Data:Talk.handle.beast.json.label: Time with the Beastie
Data:Talk.handle.beast.json.startdescription: Offer this beast my company. Who knows? Perhaps it will offer something in return.
Data:Talk.handle.beast.json.desc: And now, it suggests, a meal would be welcome.

Data:Talk.incident.irrelevant.json.startdescription: [This visitor isn't interested in that. Find a visitor with matching interests.]

Data:Talk.json.label: Talk
Data:Talk.json.desc: Speak to visitors, assistants, strangers, friends...

Data:Talk.setup.json.label: Help?
Data:Talk.setup.json.desc: Above me, atop the cliffs, lies Brancrug Village. I'll never reach it in this storm, but if I can only muster my remaining strength to find help... [Clicking a slot will highlight cards and objects which can go there.]

Data:Talk.visitor.agdistis.intro.json.label: A Conversation with Mr Agdistis
Data:Talk.visitor.agdistis.intro.json.startdescription: 'How do you do, Librarian. I crave your assistance.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.aladim.json.label: A Conversation with the Aleppine
Data:Talk.visitor.aladim.json.startdescription: 'Peace be with you. I ask entry to the House.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.arthur.json.label: A Conversation with Lieutenant Moore
Data:Talk.visitor.arthur.json.startdescription: 'Good day to you. May I come in?' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.arun.json.label: A Conversation with Dr Peel
Data:Talk.visitor.arun.json.startdescription: 'The day, the night, and here we are again in the day. Marvellous.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.auntmopsy.json.label: A Conversation with a Friendly Aunt
Data:Talk.visitor.auntmopsy.json.startdescription: 'You don't need to invite me in, dear. Someone else already has...' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.azita.json.startdescription: 'Hello, Librarian. I have questions; I'll pay for answers.' [If there's an Incident card active, you can discuss it - or just leave the slot empty and offer a Consultation.]

Data:Talk.visitor.consultation.edge.read.desc: 'How invigorating.' [You've satisfied your visitor and earnt a reward. But the more they learn, the harder they'll be to satisfy in future.]
